# Park Public Benefit (园区公共收益)
Vue frontend project (repo zhi2-web-admin) for park property management, focused on the public-benefit module.

## Description
- Vue frontend project sharing the zhi2-web-admin base with 园区物管2.0.
- Business covers property-management-area four-map slots, account splitting, building-table view, and benefit new-pages (use-money apply, expenditure contract filing, etc.).
- Branch naming examples: develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang, develop/v2.6.2-yuanqu.

## Known Technical Patterns
- ComplexPhoto four-slot, sub-table form pass, view height switch, regulatory link init
- fund payment notice contract-name jump, autonomous notice dynamic route, submit-approval URL moved to flowApi
- dialog narrow-column pager wrap fix, bank detail daily-reconcile receipt view split, dialog batch tip & form side-by-side wrap fix
- todo reject prefix norm, withdraw approvalApi check, landPlotCode write zs-remark head, bank receipt column mirror disorder, todo reject red render, user-role dropdown mis-pass roleType, operating-room business-status filter, account-detail dialog three-block form bind
- building-range field changed to landPlotCode/landPlotName, DetailTemplate PDF mixed card, zs-operate-column fixed-width clip three buttons, receipt write-off voucher 0-attachment bug
- custom list column order no re-sort add key, zs-table-column add title widen, select-dialog auxiliary link Optional route, el-form prop/rules key consistency
- todo jump history path compat, zs-table concurrent re-sort fail fix, project-type check scattered silent
- owners-committee filing detail user-auth entry, done/my-initiated list remove todo prev-step column, room dialog page-turn scrollTop reset, table reset doLayout scroll fix
- building-table view floor-unit mismatch column fix, frontend decrypt key pairing norm, global request auto-append route meta menu head, dialog table bottom occlusion fix
- filed detail create worker entry, account-type dictValue mismatch, detailMixins form cache skip
- asset-part same-route jump no response & route-name misjudge, owners-committee property-fee proof required by owner identity, file-content check not required causing missing asterisk
- empty property-area list no dialog change to warning, mathjs add empty ||0 fallback, Object prop not merge default causing treeMethod error
- attachment drawer hardcode z-index blocking global image preview, building-relate dialog unified columns compat
- zs-table cell event not null-check error, zs-operate-column undeclared attr warning, notice year string/number strict-equal fail, bash script quote truncation diag
- select-dialog auxiliary link Optional route, B-terminal filter per-page inject, B-terminal regulatory link init
- use-money apply dialog area columns need dictionary formatter, expenditure contract dialog area columns lack dictionary formatter
- bank receipt query unreconciled check blocking reconciled query, bank receipt reconciled row wrongly showing write-off button
- parking type filter overriding dict causing numeric display
- collapse-container margin override and spacer element losing page spacing
- resources lease contract street/community columns lack formatter
- zs-operate-column disabled still triggers delete
- committee member view dialog missing appointment end date
- building auth dialog table reuse zs-table style
